title: Performance review: quadratic pattern families + general scaling
description:
General performance review of the similarity/health pipeline, including:

- **Quadratic pattern family detection** (from codex review of sutra/92, finding 3): `find_pattern_families` compares every vector pair unconditionally during parse. O(n²) on 1024-dim vectors with no cap, index, batching, or timeout. Stalls indexing on larger workspaces. Location: src/pipeline.rs:610-615.
  → Move behind bounded background path, or pre-bucket by cheap AST fingerprints/LSH, or add function-count cap.

- Broader scaling audit: HRR encoding cost per symbol, snapshot write volume, similarity search query performance at scale."
